Hi Anika — I saw Okta's Senior Software Engineer opening on the Lifecycle Management team and noticed your team owns the SCIM provisioning surface. I've spent the last three years building SCIM 2.0 (RFC 7643/7644) connectors and group-push flows for enterprise IdPs, which maps closely to the listing's lifecycle automation scope. Would you be open to 15 minutes on Tuesday or Wednesday so I can ask how the team is scoping the role?
Thanks,

Rather than apply cold, I'd value 15 minutes next week to hear what the team actually needs in the first quarter. Would Tuesday or Thursday work?
